mapper.sql: a.id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover_image, a.category_id, a.author_id, a.status, a.is_top, a.is_original, a.source_url, a.view_count, a.like_count, a.comment_count, a.publish_time, a.created_at, a.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT , a.content, u.nickname AS author_name, u.username AS author_username, c.name AS category_name FROM `article` a LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = a.author_id LEFT JOIN `category` c ON c.id = a.category_id WHERE a.id = #{id}
SELECT , a.content FROM `article` a WHERE a.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `article` (title, summary, content, cover_image, category_id, author_id, status, is_top, is_original, source_url, view_count, like_count, comment_count, publish_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{coverImage}, #{categoryId}, #{authorId}, #{status}, #{isTop}, #{isOriginal}, #{sourceUrl}, 0, 0, 0, #{publishTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE `article` SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `article` SET status = #{status}, publish_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 1 AND publish_time IS NULL THEN NOW() ELSE publish_time END WHERE id = #{id}
